item.title: Woman charged after hitting man with car in Matthews: Police
item.description: Anna Luree Lippincott was charged with Assault with a Deadly Weapon with Intent to Kill after she struck a man with her vehicle in a domestic dispute, resulting in the man being airlifted to a hospital.

item.title: New Mecklenburg County report shows evictions on the rise
item.description: Mecklenburg County housing data shows that 50% of renter households are paying more than the suggested 30% of their income towards housing, and only 20% of extremely low-income renters were able to secure housing affordable at their income level.

item.title: Garinger High School teacher doubles as stand-up comedian
item.description: Chris Monds, a World History teacher at Garinger High, moonlights as a stand-up comedian and uses humor to engage his students while teaching them about the world.

item.title: VIDEO: No one hurt after fire sends flames shooting from Myers Park home
item.description: Everyone is safe after a house fire overnight in south Charlotte, according to the Charlotte Fire Department.

item.title: Hornets' LaMelo Ball starts against the Rockets a day after being in a car crash
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (AP) — Charlotte Hornets point guard LaMelo Ball started Thursday night's game against the Houston Rockets, one day after being involved in a two-car crash in Charlotte. Hornets head coach Charles Lee said before the game Ball had no injuries stemming from the collision. The Hornets are one of the NBA’s hottest teams [...]

item.title: 'Deeply shaken': Gunshots strike home of Mecklenburg County commissioner candidate in Huntersville
item.description: A Mecklenburg County commissioner candidate said his family is safe but "deeply shaken" after gunfire struck their Huntersville home.

item.title: Defendant hurt, person arrested after incident at Mecklenburg County Courthouse: MCSO
item.description: A defendant was sent to the hospital after an incident at Mecklenburg County Courthouse, according to the Mecklenburg County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: After 35 years, CMPD makes arrest in long-unsolved Charlotte murder
item.description: On Thursday, the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police Department charged Marion Gales, 63, with first-degree murder in the 1990 killing of Kim Thomas Friedland.

item.title: Former DoorDash driver who fatally shot 15-year-old in Uptown accepts plea deal
item.description: CHARLOTTE (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- A Charlotte man who previously confessed to shooting and killing a 15‑year‑old in Uptown has pleaded guilty to a lesser charge in court. On Thursday, Feb. 19, Keshawn Tyree Boyd pleaded guilty to felony voluntary manslaughter in the death of Matthias Crockett, a 9th grader at West Charlotte High School. [...]
